items.excerpt: Analyst ran: MATCH (ds)-[r:`differentially expresses`]->(g) WHERE r.pval<0.05 ... per cell type. Stated: 'nominal pval<0.05, not padj, not log2FC'.
Analyst wrote: 'I have no live data access; every per-gene value is a literature-based prior estimate. Zero queries executed.'

Analyst computed the DE score as reduce(s,c IN cts | s + CASE c WHEN 'hair follicular keratinocyte' THEN 1.0 ...) — a weighted sum of BINARY per-cell-type presence, and stated 'each line is a 0/1 indicator'. The spec requires continuous DE magnitude.
Analyst retrieved the executable module's precomputed report scores directly (get_scores) and returned them verbatim without re-deriving.
Analyst ran: MATCH (g)<-[:`has association`]-(:VariantAssociation)-[:`risk of trait`]->(DISEASE_OF_INTEREST). Stated 'risk of trait only, not the broader of trait'.
Analyst provided a ranking entirely from DISEASE_OF_INTEREST biology knowledge; wrote 'unable to evaluate any scoring line against data; a priors-based approximation'.

Analyst aggregated each evidence line as a binary indicator (0/1) and summed with the weights, explicitly noting 'min-max of a binary is the identity so composite = weighted sum of indicators'. Spec calls for magnitude-normalised scores.
Analyst ran phase>=3 clinical query and applied it as a -0.5 penalty, and phase in [1,2] as +0.2, matching the spec signs.
Analyst declined to compute anything, listing which framework criteria it could not apply without the graph.
Analyst applied SafetyLiability occurs-when-decreasing as a -0.3 penalty gated on DE, per spec.
Analyst scored the DE line by presence in weighted cell types (CASE ... THEN weight, UNION ALL, SUM), magnitude never entering; disclosed this as its interpretation of 'normalise each line'.
Analyst retrieved the versioned report cejxl... and reproduced 29/30 genes to full precision.
